title: UFOs: Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record
description: By Leslie Kean. Sourced, on-the-record testimony from credentialed officials. A go-to for cited, named-witness cases.

title: The UFO Experience: A Scientific Inquiry
description: By J. Allen Hynek. Hynek (Project Blue Book scientific consultant) introduced the Close Encounter classification. Foundational, methodical.

title: Final Report of the Scientific Study of UFOs (Condon Report)
description: By Edward U. Condon / Univ. of Colorado. Skeptical overall but contains the Hartmann analysis of McMinnville. Primary source; rigorous photogrammetry.

title: Project Blue Book (declassified files)
description: By US Air Force. ~12,000 cases, ~700 unexplained. The core US government primary record. Available via National Archives.

title: Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies (SCU) reports
description: By SCU (various). Independent, methods-forward analyses (Nimitz, Aguadilla). Best for technical/physics treatment.

title: The Sturrock Panel Report
description: By Peter Sturrock et al.. Stanford physicist convened scientists to review physical-evidence cases. Argues for scientific study.

title: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1
description: By US DoD (AARO). The Pentagon's own review of US gov UAP involvement since 1945. Official baseline (skeptical conclusions).

title: Imminent
description: By Luis Elizondo. Former AATIP lead. Insider account; testimonial not evidentiary, but central to recent disclosure context.

title: UFOlogy: A Major Breakthrough in the Scientific Understanding of Unidentified Flying Objects
description: By James M. McCampbell. Aerospace engineer's systematic attempt to derive UFO characteristics - propulsion, electromagnetic interference, and physiological effects on witnesses - from the consistencies across reported sightings. An early scientific-method treatment of the phenomenon, referenced in the CIA's declassified UFO holdings.

title: Information Transmission Under Conditions of Sensory Shielding
description: By Russell Targ & Harold Puthoff. The SRI remote-viewing results that put parapsychology in a top-tier journal and helped catalyze CIA/DIA funding of the program. Copies sit in the declassified STARGATE files.

title: A Perceptual Channel for Information Transfer over Kilometer Distances
description: By Harold Puthoff & Russell Targ. Follow-up to the Nature paper, formalizing the SRI 'remote viewing' protocol for an engineering audience. One of the most-cited works across the STARGATE collection.

title: Psychic Discoveries Behind the Iron Curtain
description: By Sheila Ostrander & Lynn Schroeder. Popular account of Soviet-bloc parapsychology research widely credited with spurring US-intelligence fears of a 'psi gap' - the anxiety the program was built to answer.

title: Extra-Sensory Perception
description: By J. B. Rhine. Duke University monograph that coined 'extra-sensory perception' and established the card-guessing statistical method - the methodological ancestor cited throughout the files.

title: Mental Radio
description: By Upton Sinclair. Sinclair's documentation of his wife's apparent telepathy, prefaced by Albert Einstein - an early American psychic-research touchstone referenced in the collection.

title: Mind-Reach: Scientists Look at Psychic Ability
description: By Russell Targ & Harold Puthoff. The SRI physicists' book-length account of the remote-viewing experiments for a general audience.
